title: JournalSnapshot
requirements: 05.02. It contains exactly the required public fields: `entries` and `nextSequence`.
05.03. Direct construction validates `nextSequence` as an exact integer.
05.06. Entry sequence numbers must be strictly increasing.
05.09. Every retained entry sequence is lower than `nextSequence`.
05.10. Retained entries may begin with a sequence greater than 1.
05.11. Gaps between retained sequence numbers are permitted.
05.12. An empty snapshot is permitted when `nextSequence` is valid.
05.13. Snapshot state does not expose mutable journal container state.
